item.title: Iranian shopkeeper, just 26, 'to be HANGED after spending final minutes with family'
item.description: A young Iranian shopkeeper is set to become the first protester hanged by the Islamic Republic as it wrestles to stay in control amid widespread civil unrest. Erfan Soltani, 26, will have 10 minutes to say his goodbyes to his loved ones on Wednesday before he is killed by the regime for taking part in a demonstration last week, human rights groups have said. item.title: Teenagers lured man, 49, to beach and beat him to death with rocks as they shouted 'paedophile', court hears
item.description: Three teenagers lured a 49-year-old man to a Kent beach before beating him to death with rocks while shouting "paedophile", a court has been told. A girl, 16, and two boys, 15 and 16, met Alexander Cashford on the Isle of Sheppey prior to his death. item.title: More than 22 dead and at least 80 injured after crane COLLAPSES onto train in Thailand
item.description: At least 22 people have been killed after a construction crane collapsed onto a moving train in Thailand. The horror accident occurred in the Sikhio district of Nakhon Ratchasima province, around 143 miles north of Bangkok.According to the State Railway of Thailand, 195 passengers were onboard the train at the time of the incident.
